title: Eight seconds were enough
summary: Philadelphia took a late lead in London, but a returnable kickoff gave Jacksonville the field position for Cam Little’s winning 57-yard field goal. The Jaguars won 19–17.

timeline.label: Late possession
timeline.text: Jake Elliott made a 48-yard field goal to put Philadelphia ahead.

timeline.label: Eight seconds left
timeline.text: Ameer Abdullah returned the ensuing kickoff into Philadelphia territory.

timeline.label: Final kick
timeline.text: Little converted from 57 yards to win.

unusual: A kickoff designed to use time also allowed a long return. Field position mattered more than the few seconds consumed.
explanations: Sirianni subsequently said he regretted not kicking through the end zone. A touchback would have changed the task for Jacksonville; it would not guarantee a Philadelphia win.
questions: The reviewed reports differ by one yard on the return distance. No win-probability model is presented.
